Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Dance Academy of Excellence offers a variety of dance, drama, and music instruction for students of all ages, including group classes, private lessons, and performance workshops. Our facility is equipped with industry-standard dance floors and safety measures to minimize risks, ensuring a safe environment for all participants. We host recitals and showcases, providing students with opportunities to perform. Our staff is certified and trained in child protection policies, emphasizing a strong commitment to safety and effective instruction. We do not offer childcare services or serve alcohol on the premises, maintaining compliance with underwriting guidelines.
